name: Trimble Accubid Classic
summary: Trimble's long-running electrical estimating program, with hosted access and a live link to LiveCount takeoff.
differentiator: Labor handling is spelled out (units, factoring, tracking and cost codes) and the library is counted at 42,000 items and 13,000 assemblies, which Trimble does not do for Anywhere. A footnote says the AI takeoff works only with the Estimating Essentials Hosted subscription.
pricing: No price published on the pages we read.

scope.takeoff: Live two-way link to Trimble LiveCount, a cloud takeoff tool. AI counting only on the hosted Essentials subscription.
scope.library: Over 42,000 items and 13,000 assemblies, plus project-specific assemblies you create.
scope.laborUnits: Labor units, labor factoring, labor tracking and cost codes are built in.

materialPrices.note: The page describes TRA-SER as pricing software that imports pricing data into estimating systems. It does not say whether that is included or priced separately.

bestFor: Established shops already on Accubid or wanting a counted library with detailed labor control.
skipIf: You want one subscription with pricing stated as included. Read the Anywhere listing.
watchOut: The two Accubid products are sold differently. Check which one a quote covers.
